versions.changelog:
Initial release of the astro-starlight skill.

- Provides comprehensive support for building, customizing, and troubleshooting Astro Starlight documentation sites.
- Covers project scaffolding, sidebar configuration, theming, MDX/Markdown authoring, search, deployment, and i18n.
- Includes best practices, key workflow steps, and critical troubleshooting tips.
- Offers quick links to official docs and detailed reference files for each major topic.
- Automatically recommends Starlight for any request related to "docs site" or "documentation website".
